title: Hybrid calibration harness & throughput/latency matrix for mixed-precision long-context workloads
creator: Anika Shah
description:
Goal: Build a reusable harness that runs a controlled throughput/latency matrix across FP8 and INT8 profiles (and a small set of mixed-precision variants) for long-context workloads, and validate accuracy regressions introduced by calibration. This ticket covers experiment design, infra runs, and delivery of dashboards + runbooks so platform and model teams can reproduce and choose operational defaults.

Why: Prior experiments focus on throughput/latency at short contexts or large batches; customers with retrieval or multi-turn chat (2k-8k tokens) need quantization guidance that accounts for KV-cache warmup, batching tradeoffs, and kernel selection differences on H100/A100. We also need deterministic accuracy validation steps to catch silent regressions from calibration.

Scope:
- Implement harness that sweeps: model variants (baseline fp16, fp8-calibrated, int8-calibrated), batch sizes [1,4,8,16], sequence lengths [512,2048,8192], and two KV-cache states (cold start, warmed after prefix).
- Run on two instance types: A100-80GB and H100-80GB (single-GPU nodes) to capture kernel/runtime behavior differences.
- Measure: median/95th/99th token latency, throughput (tokens/sec), GPU utilization, memory headroom, and CPU-side latency tail.
- Accuracy checks: standardized perplexity on held-out webtext slice, and downstream classification/regression delta on two eval sets (RLHF-style preference set and intent-classification), plus prompt-level exact-match checks where applicable.
- Provide automated report generation and a console dashboard with cost-per-token and regression flags.

Out-of-scope: multi-GPU sharding, autoscaling policies, and dedicated capacity billing changes (follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run the full sweep automated via a single CLI invocation and YAML config
Complete matrix runs for baseline fp16, fp8-calib, int8-calib on A100 and H100 for defined batch/seq permutations
Accuracy delta report produced with clear pass/fail thresholds (perplexity <= 2% increase OR downstream metric within defined bounds)
Dashboard in Console (or shared Grafana) shows latency p50/p95/p99, throughput, GPU utilization and cost estimates per run
A reproducible runbook and a GitHub PR with the harness code + dataset pointers merged
test_plan: Datasets: 10k-line held-out webtext slice for perplexity; 2k examples for classification/regression evals; prompt templates saved in repo
Calibration: run existing calib pipeline with 5 seeds per profile; store calibration artifacts and checksums
Runs: for each model-profile x batch x seq x kvcache-state run 3 trials and aggregate median and 95th percentile
Metrics collection: use telemetry agent to record per-token timing, kernel selection logs, and memory traces; tag runs with git SHA and runtime-1.22
Validation: run downstream eval harness post-calibration and compare to baseline fp16 with statistical significance testing (bootstrap)

2025-02-13 - Infra update: Cluster team granted 24 H100-hours on test queue; provisional schedule set for 2025-02-17 to 2025-02-18. Mateo to add infra labels to runs.
2025-02-16 - Engineering decision: include a mixed-precision variant (fp8 for attention+ffn, int8 for output projections) to capture operational sweet spots. Added to sweep matrix.

2025-02-18 - Progress: baseline fp16 and fp8 calib runs completed on A100 for seq=512/2048. Observed a 7% tokens/sec improvement for fp8 at batch=8 on A100, but a 10-12% tail latency regression at seq=2048 when KV-cache cold. Next: run H100 and downstream evals.
